evidence.detail: PR 'Make deck names smarter about seasons, version, and roman numerals' merged 2024-04-07 added remove_season(name, d.season_id) to normalize()
Introduces remove_season() and passes d.season_id to normalize(); the root cause bakert cited was that deck_name didn't know which season a deck was from
normalize() calls remove_season(name, d.season_id), which strips the season number from the deck name
remove_season() with season_id=13 matches '13' at word boundary and replaces it with ' ', leaving '- Izzet Swans'; remove_extraneous_hyphens() then yields 'Izzet Swans'
Test assert deck_name.remove_season('31 - Storm', 31) == '- Storm' confirms the analogous pattern works; full pipeline then strips the hyphen

triage.notes: No test specifically for '13 - Izzet Swans' through the full normalize pipeline; confidence medium rather than high for this reason. The analogous '31 - Storm' test covers the same code path.
triage.proposed_comment: This was fixed in PR #12145 (commit 6f78f1ec, April 2024), which added `remove_season(name, d.season_id)` to `normalize()`. A deck named '13 - Izzet Swans' with season_id=13 now correctly normalizes to 'Izzet Swans' — the `remove_season` function strips the leading 13 and `remove_extraneous_hyphens` cleans up the remaining hyphen.
